PAGE_DESCRIPTION: Work through issues that need a decision or action, know who is handling each one, and see when recovery is confirmed.
QUEUE_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: New issues appear here when a responsible service reports something that needs a decision or action.
FILTERED_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Reset or change the filters to see other issues.
PERMISSION_TITLE: This item isn't available to you
PERMISSION_DESCRIPTION: Your current platform access does not allow this view or action. Nothing was changed.
ERROR_DESCRIPTION: Current issues couldn't be loaded. Check the connection and try again.
CONFLICT_TITLE: This item changed while you were working
CONFLICT_DESCRIPTION: Your change was not applied. Reload the current item before deciding what to do next.
DETAIL_DESCRIPTION: Review the impact, what the responsible service reported, work history, and confirmation of recovery.
RESOLVED_READ_ONLY_DESCRIPTION: Work status is now read-only, but you can still review its history.
ACTIONS_DESCRIPTION: Update who owns this item, its status, or when it should return. The original issue and your data access stay unchanged.
REMINDER_REASON_PLACEHOLDER: Explain what should be checked when this item returns
NOTE_PLACEHOLDER: Record a handoff, observation, or what to check next
NOTE_REQUIRED: Write a note before adding it.
ACTION_APPLIED: Work status updated. The original issue is unchanged.
NO_ALLOWED_ACTIONS: You can view this issue, but you can't change its work status.
ASSIGNEES_ERROR: People you can assign couldn't be loaded. Assignment stays unavailable until the list has refreshed.
REMINDER_REASON_REQUIRED: Explain why this issue needs another reminder later.
EVIDENCE_CONTRACT_ERROR_DESCRIPTION: The source service can't provide complete details right now. Reload after the service has recovered.
HISTORY_EMPTY: No one has changed this issue's work status yet.
HISTORY_IN_PROGRESS: This issue was marked in progress
HISTORY_NEEDS_ATTENTION: This issue returned to needs attention
NOTES_EMPTY: No work notes have been recorded.
REMEDIATION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED: You can investigate this issue, but recovery in the responsible service requires someone with access.
REMEDIATION_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE: This version of Arclayer Admin can't open the recovery action in the responsible service. Open that service to continue.
BACKGROUND_JOB_FAILED_EXPLANATION: The responsible service reported it could not complete this task.
BACKGROUND_JOB_FAILED_IMPACT: The requested result remains incomplete until the responsible service completes the task.
BACKGROUND_JOB_FAILED_PRIORITY: This unfinished task is prioritized for investigation.
BACKGROUND_JOB_RESOLUTION_CONDITION: Recovery is confirmed when the responsible service reports that the original task finished or no longer needs attention.
